active_state.motion_arithmetic: select signed s16 (x,y) by direction_u8; sign-extend, shift left 8, add to 16.16 x/y

substate_0.transition_guard: direction is 0x10/0x30, or u8(direction-0x10) >= 0x20, or u16(y_high-z_high) >= 0x009c
update_order: phase-bit-0 clear allocates record24 class0x49 variant1

substate_2.direction_step: low nibble zero increments substate to 4; otherwise add +1 when bit4 clear or -1 when bit4 set

substate_4_guards_in_order: health_s16 < 0 -> state 4 and global effect flag
u16(y_high) < u16(z_high) -> state 4 and global effect flag
substate_4_update_order: phase-bit-0 clear allocates record24 class0x49 variant1

allocation.allocation_failure: player phase/presentation continues; no class-3 actor
allocation.owner_action_guard: player state 0x0200 action 0x0402; airborne Button1 edge/resource helper 0x0241f0 accepts

child_emitter_state.terminal_guard: signed predecremented child count < 0 increments state to 6
child_emitter_state.x_sign_rule: negate row x when parent facing is zero

collision_state.guard: signed health below zero or unsigned y below z

state2.timer_guard: predecrement timer_u8; zero releases in the same dispatch
state2.variant_guard: nonzero variant adds signed global +0x2c0 to x high word

effect_allocation.guard: global phase byte +0x19 bit0 is clear
effect_allocation.writes: copy parent x/y/z, facing and animation record; timer receives D6

initialization.position_rule: add selected signed x/y offsets; negate x when facing is zero; decrement z high word by one

player_phase_0x0406.landing_guard: unsigned carry clear from world z versus world y enters 0x023630
player_phase_0x0406.motion_rule: same signed 16.16 velocity and acceleration update as phase 0x0402

record4_class03.scheduler: record type 4 in ascending slot order before record type 8

suppression_control.downstream_pool_effect: the intentionally free record-4 slot changes later allocator slot identities and shifts two later actor-origin command frames; it is not presentation-only

button2.held_or_repeated_edge: does not auto-repeat or enter a gated continuation when +0x6e animation-event byte remains zero

airborne_actions.motion: all required branches return through 0x01a8e6 and source landing 0x023630
airborne_actions.rng_consumption: none for action, direction, phase, or presentation selection

directional_actions.cleanup: 0x01a3fa clears action; 0x0198de returns to source idle/locomotion dispatch
directional_actions.facing: latched from +0x0f; direction-specific fixed-point vectors are selected before airborne updates

motion_and_landing.cleanup: 0x01a3fa clears action then 0x0198de returns to idle/locomotion

landing_0x023630.terrain_mode_zero_write: world_y high word = world_z high word; preserve the existing world_y fractional low word

phase_0x0402.landing_guard: carry clear after signed world_y versus world_z comparison

phase_0x040a.x_step: signed x_velocity; negate before add when facing == 0

mutation_controls: reject vector magnitude or sign mutation
reject presentation selector or record mutation
reject landing comparison polarity or terrain-mode guard mutation
reject phase or timer transition mutation
reject physical-edge to dispatcher chronology mutation
implementation_contract.scheduler: player actor slot is updated once in fixed actor-pool scheduler order before current-state collision and presentation submission

source_input.entry_guard: new Button3 edge; state dispatcher writes 0x0400 and initialization runs only when timer_s16_at_0x24 < 0

directional_actions.input_guard: new Button3 edge at actor +0xee/+0xef bit 6
directional_actions.landing_guard: 0x01a8e6 signed world-Y versus world-Z comparison; carry clear enters 0x023630

interruption.rule: source HIT entry advances the inner dispatcher, clears buffered/action-local state, and replaces the airborne action; damage and HIT recovery remain owned by the player HIT/KO authority checkpoint

mutation_controls: reject a NOT_REQUIRED phase once a route witness appears

not_required_for_round1.mutation_rule: a future route witness for any phase reopens this family and forbids retaining NOT_REQUIRED_FOR_ROUND1

phases.0x0408: dispatcher body exists but has no entry in either completion, failure/continue, perturbed, or input-only targeted routes
phases.0x0412: requires +0x6e animation-event continuation from an air attack; all reachable PW air-attack records keep the guard clear
phases.0x0414: requires the 0x01a932 direction/terrain-mask reversal guard; directional Button3-repeat counterfactual does not satisfy it
